featured.insightZh: Latent Space 主理人、Cognition 与 aidotengineer 关联的 Swyx 这周抛出一个被低估的 alpha：如果你还没把 Codex / Claude / Gemini / Devin 之类的自动化任务，设成每周自动研究「怎么提升自己的 SEO/AEO」，那你就是在白白错过本该商品化、却诡异地没人用的免费红利。他进一步把话题引向更前沿的问题——AEO 到底是「on-policy」的（比如让 Claude 帮你优化 AEO，是不是会不成比例地只在 Claude 上生效）还是可泛化的？他说这层 alpha 只有等大家都停止问这种问题、开始讨论前者时才会消失。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who leads Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, fired off a few posts Friday announcing reset usage limits for all paid Codex and ChatGPT Work users—"Oops... I did it again"—and joked it may have transitively reset other rate limits out there too. He credited an incredible team iterating at lightspeed and keeping infra up while scaling faster than ever, and confirmed GPT-5.6 Sol is "an extremely good model."
featured.insightZh: OpenAI 负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT 的 Thibault Sottiaux 周五连发几条，宣布给所有付费用户重置 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的使用额度——用他自己带梗的话说「Oops... I did it again」，还调侃可能顺带把外面其他地方的 rate limit 也一起重置了。他把功劳归给一支「以光速迭代、在我们比以往更快扩张时还能扛住基础设施」的团队。另外他确认 GPT-5.6 Sol「确实是个极其优秀的模型」。

featured.sourceName: The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck
featured.title: OpenAI's Compute Chief: We Can't Build Fast Enough | Sachin Katti
featured.summaryEn: Demand far outstrips compute supply, so OpenAI is building "industrial compute" as an entirely new business, and its biggest worry isn't overbuilding but not building fast enough. Sachin Katti is OpenAI's Head of Industrial Compute—in host Matt Turck's words, maybe the most fascinating and relevant title in tech right now. With a background spanning a Stanford professorship, multiple startups, and a recent stint as Intel's CTO, he's leading what many call the largest infrastructure buildout in human history. He describes data centers as "giant factories that are turning electrons into tokens," requiring liquid cooling everywhere—chips, halls, even cables and transformers—because "the hotter the chip, the more memory bandwidth you get, the more flops you get." On power, OpenAI commits to never taking power away from the grid, instead funding new generation, transmission, and substation i…
featured.insightZh: 需求远超算力供给，OpenAI 现在把「工业级算力」当成一门全新业务在建，最大的担忧不是过度建设，而是「建得不够快」。 Sachin Katti 是 OpenAI 的 Head of Industrial Compute——用主持人 Matt Turck 的话说，可能是当下科技圈最迷人也最贴题的头衔。他背景横跨斯坦福教授、多次创业者、以及最近的 Intel CTO，如今在领导许多人称之为「人类史上最大规模基础设施建设」的工程。他把数据中心形象地称作「把电子变成 token 的巨型工厂」，需要在数据中心、芯片乃至连接芯片的线缆和变压器上全方位液冷，因为「芯片跑得越热，算力越强」。 在电力上，OpenAI 承诺「绝不从电网抢电」，而是反过来投资发电、输电和变电基础设施——一个副产品是美国乃至全球电网因此被快速升级；在电网撑不住的地方则转向「表后发电」（目前主要是燃气轮机），让数据中心自给自足。他对核能态度积极：「it can't come soon enough」，认为是最密集、最清洁、可规模化的能源。他还谈到 OpenAI 自研芯片 Jalapeno（九个月从设计到流片），核心指标是「每瓦能产多少 token」；以及新网络协议 MRC 用多路径「喷洒」来优雅掩盖大集群里无处不在的故障。 最耐人寻味的是「AI 造 AI」的递归：他说这一天「不远了」——AI 正在协助设计和优化芯片，而由于 AI 本身能做 AI 研究，能跑的实验数量爆炸式增长，反过来让研究所需算力也爆炸。他反复强调需求的不可满足：「Demand far outstrips compute supply today. So anything we can bring online, we consume immediately.」

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang, Roblox product lead and AI tutorials creator, floated a resonant product vision: staring at screens all day managing agents fries his brain, so he'd rather walk around outside talking to agents "on the phone," handing out work and getting voice status updates—waiting for the first lab to ship it. He also declared Codex browser use has "finally been defeated" and teased a weekend episode with Anthropic's Thariq (trq212) on AI video workflows.
items.insightZh: Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 提了个很戳中当下的产品愿景：整天盯着屏幕管理一堆 agent 让他脑子发麻，他更想像「打电话」那样，一边在户外散步一边给 agent 派活、让它们用语音向他汇报进度，等着哪家实验室先把这个做出来。他还说 Codex 的 browser use 终于被「击败」了，并预告周末会放出一期跟 Anthropic 的 Thariq（trq212）录的 AI 视频工作流的重磅节目。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana）
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru, Sr Director of AI at Meta and formerly Google's Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana lead, offered a sharp diagnosis of why enterprises struggle to move beyond basic chatbots: a talent gap across three capabilities. Evals—do you understand your use cases and replicate them as offline and online evals that express your ambition and push the jagged frontier? Harness—do you have a system for routing, multiagent orchestration, context management, tool calling, and memory independent of the models? Talent—do you have peo…
items.insightZh: Meta AI 高级总监、前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人 Madhu Guru 对「企业为什么迈不过基础聊天机器人这道坎」下了个很狠的诊断：核心是三个能力的人才缺口。一是 Evals——你到底有没有清楚理解自己的用例，并把它变成离线和在线评测；这些评测能不能表达你的野心、逼到模型能力的锯齿边界、帮你在质量-成本-延迟曲线上选对模型。二是 Harness——你有没有一套独立于模型之外、能管路由、多智能体编排、上下文管理、工具调用和记忆的系统。三是 Talent——你有没有能在前沿把这一切搭出来的人，这是最稀缺的一环。他另外点评 Kimi 其实伤不到 Google：多数企业不会直接用 Kimi，而是通过 Google Cloud 用，因为它们要的是安全、数据驻留、合规，最重要的是芯片——钱从一个口袋进另一个口袋。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq, on Anthropic's Claude Code team, shared a practical token-saving lesson: building prototypes of mockups, schemas, data models, and proofs of concept is the best way to realize you don't actually want the output before spending tons of tokens on it.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 分享了一条很实用的省 token 心得：先做 mockup、schema、数据模型、概念验证这类原型，是在你烧掉大量 token 之前、就先搞清楚「你其实并不想要这个输出」的最佳办法。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie gave a clear-eyed take on who benefits as AI gets cheaper: the cheaper AI gets, the more opportunity for the whole ecosystem—especially end-customers—because everything is bottlenecked by deploying AI cost-effectively in real workloads, and lowering cost raises total usage while value accrues to all layers of the stack. His counterintuitive twist: as AI gets efficient, demand even for frontier closed models can rise, since you often need the strongest model for orchestration then farm bulk toke…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 就「AI 变便宜到底利好谁」给出一段清醒分析：AI 越便宜，整个生态（尤其是终端客户）的机会越大，因为一切都卡在能否成功且低成本地把 AI 部署进真实工作负载——每次降低 AI 成本，总用量就上去，价值会沿栈的各层扩散。他补充一个反直觉的修正：AI 变高效后，连前沿闭源模型的需求也可能上升，因为你常常需要最强的模型来做任务编排，再把大批 token 的活外包给更便宜或更专精的模型。这种效率提升反而可能带来更多前沿花费，真正承压的是利润率——而智能最终应当收敛到基础设施栈的利润率水平。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang, author of the Follow Builders project, offered grounded advice for building in public: if making content feels like extra work, show the work already happening inside your product—a tiny screen recording, the first version, or the user behavior that changed your design; the reasoning matters more than production value. She also noted technology reshaping culture: a few years ago many were uncomfortable recording meetings, now it's assumed all business meetings are recorded—not for humans, but for agent…
items.insightZh: Follow Builders 项目作者 Zara Zhang 给「build in public」的人一条很落地的建议：如果做内容让你觉得是额外负担，那就把产品里本来就在发生的工作直接展示出来——一小段屏幕录制、第一个版本、或是改变了你设计的用户行为。推理过程比制作精良更重要。她还观察到一个技术改变文化的例子：几年前很多人还很抗拒录会，现在大家默认所有商务会议都会被录——但不是录给人看，而是录给 agent。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 与 OpenAI 相关、AI agent 折腾者
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger, affiliated with OpenClaw and OpenAI, captured an amazing-yet-painful moment: watching codex use browser + computer use to open Chrome, go to his PR, tap a comment, and wrangle the macOS file picker—all just to upload an image, since GitHub having no API doesn't stop it. He now runs codex in VMs so they don't steal app focus, and floated a pointed question: "Are we still talking loops or did we shift to graphs yet?"
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 与 OpenAI 相关的 Peter Steinberger 记录了一个既惊叹又心痛的场景：看着 codex 动用 browser + computer use 打开 Chrome、跳到他的 PR、点评论、跟 macOS 的文件选择器较劲——就为了上传一张图片。GitHub 没有对应 API 也拦不住它。他现在让 codex 都跑在 VM 里，免得抢应用焦点。另外他抛了句意味深长的行业发问：「我们还在聊 loop，还是已经转向 graph 了？」

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official Claude account posted a policy update on Fable 5 availability: starting July 20, Claude Fable 5 will be included in all Max and Team Premium plans at 50% of limits; Pro and Team Standard users keep access via usage credits and get a one-time $100 credit. They acknowledged Fable demand has been challenging to predict, which is why it rolled out in stages with several access extensions, and pledged continued investment in new capacity.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方 Claude 账号就 Fable 5 的可用性做了政策公告：从 7 月 20 日起，Claude Fable 5 将纳入所有 Max 和 Team Premium 套餐，按限额的 50% 提供；Pro 和 Team Standard 用户继续通过用量额度访问 Fable，并一次性获赠 100 美元额度。他们坦承 Fable 的需求「极难预测」，所以此前分阶段推出、多次延长访问范围，并承诺持续投入新产能、随时更新进展。

items.title: An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
items.summaryEn: Anthropic Engineering published a postmortem on a month of "Claude Code got worse" reports, tracing them to three separate changes affecting Claude Code, the Agent SDK, and Cowork—not the API—all fixed by April 20 (v2.1.116). The root causes: dropping the default reasoning effort from high to medium on March 4 (reverted April 7, now xhigh for Opus 4.7 and high elsewhere); a March 26 caching optimization bug that cleared thinking history every turn, making Claude forgetful and repetitive (fixed April 10); and an April 16 system prompt line to cut verbosity that hurt coding quality (reverted April 20). "We never intentionally degrade our models," they wrote, pledging per-model evals, line-by-line ablations, gradual rollouts, and soak periods for future prompt changes, plus having more internal staff use the exact public build. Usage limits were reset for all subscribers on April 23.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Engineering 发布了一篇针对近一个月「Claude Code 质量下降」用户反馈的复盘。他们把问题追溯到三个互相独立的改动——只影响 Claude Code、Claude Agent SDK 和 Claude Cowork，API 未受影响，全部已在 4 月 20 日（v2.1.116）修复。三个根因分别是：3 月 4 日把 Claude Code 默认推理档从 high 降到 medium（4 月 7 日回滚，现改为 Opus 4.7 默认 xhigh、其余模型 high）；3 月 26 日一个缓存优化的 bug 导致每一轮都错误清空历史思考，让模型显得健忘重复（4 月 10 日修复）；4 月 16 日一条控制冗长度的系统提示词误伤了编码质量（4 月 20 日回滚）。他们直言「We never intentionally degrade our models」，并承诺后续对系统提示词改动加更严格的分模型评测、逐行消融、灰度发布和 soak period，还会让更多内部员工使用与公开版完全一致的构建。4 月 23 日起为所有订阅用户重置了使用额度。

items.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
items.summaryEn: Anthropic Engineering detailed the architecture behind Managed Agents: decoupling an agent into three independent interfaces—session (an append-only event log serving as a context object living outside Claude's context window), harness (the "brain" loop calling Claude and routing tool calls), and sandbox (the "hands" running code). The core idea, "decouple the brain from the hands," moves the harness out of the container so containers become interchangeable "cattle" not hand-tended "pets"; a dead container is caught as a tool-call error and passed back to Claude. It also solves VPC access and security (credentials never reach the sandbox—Git tokens injected at init, MCP tokens held in a vault via proxy). Provisioning containers on demand via tool calls dropped p50 TTFT ~60% and p95 over 90%. They frame it as a "meta-harness" for "programs as yet unthought of," echoing how OS abstraction…
items.insightZh: Anthropic Engineering 介绍了 Managed Agents 的架构思路：把 agent 拆成三个互相独立、可各自失败或替换的接口——session（记录一切事件的只读追加日志，充当活在 Claude 上下文窗口之外的「上下文对象」）、harness（调用 Claude、把工具调用路由到基础设施的循环，作为「大脑」），以及 sandbox（Claude 跑代码改文件的「双手」）。核心比喻是「decouple the brain from the hands」：让 harness 离开容器，把容器当成可随时替换的「牛」而非需要精心照料的「宠物」；容器挂了，harness 只把它当作一次工具调用错误抛回给 Claude。这套解耦还解决了企业 VPC 接入、安全边界（凭据永不进入 sandbox，Git token 只在初始化时注入、MCP token 存在 vault 里经代理调用）等问题。性能上，容器改为按需由大脑通过工具调用来供给后，p50 TTFT 下降约 60%、p95 下降超 90%。作者把它形容成一种「meta-harness」，为「尚未想到的程序」设计，就像操作系统当年靠 process、file 这些抽象活了几十年。

items.title: New in Claude Managed Agents: self-hosted sandboxes and MCP tunnels
items.summaryEn: Claude Blog announced two enterprise capabilities for Managed Agents. Self-hosted sandboxes (public beta): a Claude Managed Agent can execute tools in a sandbox you control, keeping code execution, sensitive files, packages, services, and data inside your perimeter under your controls, while the orchestration/context/error-recovery agent loop stays on Anthropic's infrastructure. Bring your own sandbox client or use managed providers like Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, or Vercel—with Amplitude, Clay's Sculptor, and Rogo cited as builders on these combos. MCP tunnels (research preview): a lightweight gateway you deploy makes a single outbound connection to reach private databases, internal APIs, knowledge bases, and ticketing systems as agent tools—no public endpoints, no inbound firewall rules, end-to-end encrypted, managed by org admins in the Claude Console.
items.insightZh: Claude Blog 宣布 Managed Agents 新增两项企业级能力。一是 self-hosted sandboxes（公开测试）：Claude Managed Agent 可以在你自己控制的沙箱里执行工具，代码执行、敏感文件、包、服务和数据都留在企业边界内，受你的安全与运行时管控；负责编排、上下文管理和错误恢复的 agent loop 仍跑在 Anthropic 基础设施上。你可以自带沙箱客户端，或用 Cloudflare、Daytona、Modal、Vercel 等托管方案——文中还举了 Amplitude、Clay（Sculptor）、Rogo 等已在这些组合上构建 agent 的案例。二是 MCP tunnels（研究预览）：通过一个你自己部署的轻量网关做单向出站连接，把私有网络内的数据库、内部 API、知识库、工单系统接成 agent 可调用的工具，无需暴露到公网、无需入站防火墙规则、流量端到端加密，由组织管理员在 Claude Console 的 workspace 设置中管理。
